en: Vintage sepia postcard with two interior photographs of a richly decorated Baroque church. The upper image shows the nave with ornate ceiling paintings, carved galleries, and an elaborate altar. The lower image shows an intricately carved and painted gallery or box seating area within the same church. Decorative Art Nouveau-style framing surrounds the photos, and German captions identify the place.
